# Unconscious [Condition]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Conditions](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#UnconsciousCondition)*

While you have the Unconscious condition, you experience the following effects.

***Inert.*** You have the [Incapacitated](Incapacitated.md) and [Prone](Prone.md) conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding. When this condition ends, you remain Prone.

***Speed 0.*** Your [Speed](../Movement/Speed.md) is 0 and can't increase.

***Attacks Affected.*** [Attack rolls](../Combat/Attacks/Attack-Roll.md) against you have [Advantage](../D20-Tests/Advantage.md).

***Saving Throws Affected.*** You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity [saving throws](../D20-Tests/Saving-Throw.md).

***Automatic Critical Hits.*** Any attack roll that hits you is a [Critical Hit](../Combat/Attacks/Critical-Hit.md) if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.

***Unaware.*** You're unaware of your surroundings.
